summary: NiSource Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the closing of a public offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057, issued under an existing S-3 shelf registration statement. The notes bear fixed interest at 6.250% until April 2032, then reset to five-year Treasury plus 1.930% spread, with a 6.250% floor. Optional redemption and interest deferral features are included. This is a routine debt financing under an effective shelf, not a special situation. Proceeds and use were not detailed. What to watch: no special-situation angle; ordinary capital markets activity.
